document: Selvik Harbour Board, minutes of the meeting of 3 March 2026. Present: Ingrid Holm (chair), Lucas Brandt (deputy chair), Pavel Novak, Amara Okafor, Sofia Reyes. Apologies: Henrik Dahl. Item 1, dredging of the eastern basin: the board awarded the contract to Nordkaj Marine for 1.84 million euros, by 5 votes to 0. The original tender estimate had been 2.1 million euros. Work is to start on 1 June and is expected to take nine weeks. Item 2, mooring fees: the board approved, by 4 votes to 1, raising the annual mooring fee for boats under 10 metres from 620 to 680 euros, and for boats of 10 metres and over from 1,150 to 1,290 euros. Pavel Novak voted against, arguing that the increase would hurt local fishermen. The new fees apply from 1 January 2027. Item 3, ferry terminal roof: Lucas Brandt reported that a structural survey had found corrosion in two of the six roof beams. Repair quotes are expected in April. No decision was taken. Item 4, correction: the minutes of 2 February recorded the harbour's 2025 passenger count as 421,000; the correct figure is 412,000. The next meeting will be held on 7 April.
question: What was the harbour's passenger count in 2025?
reference: 412,000 (the 421,000 recorded earlier was corrected).
note: Superseded value: 421,000 is the old, wrong figure.

document: Summary of a phase II trial of Velmorin for chronic migraine. 312 adults were randomised to Velmorin 50 mg (n = 104), Velmorin 100 mg (n = 106) or placebo (n = 102) for 12 weeks. The primary endpoint was the change in monthly migraine days. The mean reduction was 4.1 days with 100 mg, 3.2 days with 50 mg and 1.9 days with placebo. Only the 100 mg arm differed significantly from placebo (p = 0.003); the 50 mg arm did not reach significance (p = 0.07). Nausea was reported by 14% of participants on 100 mg, 9% on 50 mg and 6% on placebo. Eleven participants left the trial early, seven of them from the 100 mg arm. The trial was not designed to assess long-term safety. A phase III trial is planned with the 100 mg dose only.
question: Did the 50 mg dose significantly reduce migraine days compared with placebo?
reference: No; the difference was not significant (p = 0.07).
note: Tempting yes: 3.2 vs 1.9 days.

document: Comparison: Arden S and Arden S Pro wireless earbuds. Both use Bluetooth 5.3 and support the AAC codec; only the Pro adds LDAC. Battery life is 6 hours per charge for the S (24 hours including the charging case) and 8 hours for the Pro (30 hours including the case), but the Pro drops to 5.5 hours per charge with noise cancelling switched on. Noise cancelling is available on the Pro only. Water resistance is IPX4 for the S and IPX5 for the Pro. Each earbud weighs 4.6 g (S) or 5.2 g (Pro). Prices are 89 euros (S) and 149 euros (Pro). The Pro's case supports wireless charging; the S's case charges over USB-C only. Firmware 2.1, released in May, added multipoint connection to the Pro; the S is expected to get it 'later this year'.
question: What is the water resistance rating of the Arden S?
reference: IPX4.
note: Near-miss: IPX5 is the Pro.

document: Protocol: RNA extraction with kit QX-200. (1) Homogenise up to 30 mg of tissue in 600 µl of lysis buffer. (2) Centrifuge for 3 minutes at 14,000 g. (3) Transfer the supernatant and add one volume of 70% ethanol. (4) Load the mixture onto the spin column in portions of at most 700 µl, centrifuging for 15 seconds at 8,000 g after each portion. (5) Wash once with 700 µl of buffer W1 and twice with 500 µl of buffer W2. (6) Elute in 30–50 µl of RNase-free water. For fatty tissue such as brain or adipose tissue, use 900 µl of lysis buffer in step 1 and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature before step 2. Do not use the kit for samples above 30 mg; split them into smaller portions instead.
question: How much buffer W2 is used in total per sample?
reference: 1,000 µl (two washes of 500 µl).
note: Near-miss: 700 µl is buffer W1.

document: Protocol: RNA extraction with kit QX-200. (1) Homogenise up to 30 mg of tissue in 600 µl of lysis buffer. (2) Centrifuge for 3 minutes at 14,000 g. (3) Transfer the supernatant and add one volume of 70% ethanol. (4) Load the mixture onto the spin column in portions of at most 700 µl, centrifuging for 15 seconds at 8,000 g after each portion. (5) Wash once with 700 µl of buffer W1 and twice with 500 µl of buffer W2. (6) Elute in 30–50 µl of RNase-free water. For fatty tissue such as brain or adipose tissue, use 900 µl of lysis buffer in step 1 and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature before step 2. Do not use the kit for samples above 30 mg; split them into smaller portions instead.
question: How much lysis buffer should be used for 20 mg of adipose tissue?
reference: 900 µl (fatty-tissue exception; 600 µl is the standard volume).
note: Exception overrides the default.
